limitations: New join: two concrete typed-greeting callers bind live connection to reader and route ready error through error/label disposal, conditional close(fd), terminal result2 and admission bypass.
Typed decoder and read-frame contracts are credited to prior packets. Frame internals, all cleanup helpers, allocator semantics and external close result are not reconstructed here.

Normal-return trace assumes valid initialized objects, formatter success, uncontended lock path, and normal return from all cleanup/clock helpers. Does not establish unwind cleanup, close success, external peer behavior or absence of reconnect by a separate task.
No native target execution, emulation, live socket or malformed network input used.
